title: Keep approved plans out of the review queue
summary: Approval and rejection mutations now publish the shared plan-queue invalidation event, so cached review responses are refreshed immediately after a plan changes state. Added a regression test covering approval followed by a cached review-queue read.
userVisibleChange: Approving a plan in the macOS eve app no longer makes it reappear on the next refresh; stale-plan removal continues to invalidate the same queue cache.

risks.title: Plan mutations invalidate the shared review queue across registered repositories.
risks.mitigation: The event only invalidates derived queue data; the next read still filters by the requested review status.

timeline.title: Locked the approved-plan lifecycle fix
timeline.summary: Scoped the fix to the macOS queue/backend mutation boundary and its regression coverage.

timeline.title: Published queue invalidations for approval and rejection
timeline.summary: Successful approve and reject routes now invalidate the cached review queue; stale dismissal retains its existing invalidation.

timeline.title: Verified Go and macOS targets
timeline.summary: Ran the focused cache regression, plan mutation tests, all Go tests, Swift package tests, Xcode macOS tests, Release build, and whitespace checks.

decisions.title: Invalidate after every successful review mutation
decisions.rationale: Approval, rejection, and stale dismissal all change the review queue and must advance the same cache generation.

decisions.title: Test the cache boundary
decisions.rationale: The user-visible regression occurs when the app refreshes after a successful mutation, so the test reads the actual review API before and after approval.

validation.output: Regression passed after the invalidation fix.
Plan approval and stale-dismissal API tests passed.

validation.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project macos/EVEApproval/EVEApproval.xcodeproj -scheme EVEApproval -configuration Release -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/eveapproval-derived-plan-cache-fix-release build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
